seo.title: Hair Designs for Men in Carlsbad, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Hair designs for men and kids in Carlsbad, NM: freestyle lines cut into the fade at Divinely Faded. Add a design to your haircut on Booksy.
seo.primary: hair designs for men carlsbad nm

paragraphs: A hair design is shape cut into the short part of a fade: a curve that sweeps back from the temple, a few lines that wrap behind the ear. It's a {{addon:hair-design}} add-on, so it rides on top of your haircut booking.

link.label: BOOK A CUT WITH A DESIGN

alt.design-skin-fade-freestyle: Freestyle line design above the ear on a skin fade with a short top
alt.design-side: Curved freestyle hair design behind the ear on a low fade with a textured top

blocks.heading: Freestyle.
blocks.lead: Placed where the fade is shortest.
paragraphs: The designs on this page are freestyle lines and curves. Look at where they sit: right where the fade goes short, above and behind the ear, so the shape shows up clean against the skin.
None of the four on this page are the same. You can bring a picture of a design you like, or tell me roughly where you want it and how bold, and we'll go from there.

blocks.heading: Kids too.
blocks.lead: Two of these are on kids.
paragraphs: A design is a simple way for a kid to make a plain fade their own. The two below sit on short fades with a little length left on top.

alt.design-kids-fade-freestyle: Boy's fade with a freestyle curved design from the temple to behind the ear
alt.design-kids-fade-lines: Boy's fade with lines cut above the ear and a textured top

blocks.heading: Add it on.
paragraphs: Book your haircut on Booksy and add the hair design to it. That works with the Essential Haircut and the Signature Cut [TIM?].
Going all in? The Luxury Grooming Experience already includes a basic hair design, along with the beard sculpt, steam, hot towels and the rest.
